faqs.question: How do corporate purchase orders and NTN tax credits work?
faqs.answer: We issue computerized commercial tax invoices containing full active STRN and NTN credentials, allowing corporate accounting departments to claim full sales tax input adjustments with the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR).

faqs.question: What are your delivery schedules across Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Karachi Metro shipments are dispatched within 24 hours. Inter-city shipments across Sindh, Punjab, and KPK arrive within 2-4 business days via verified logistics haulers.

faqs.question: Do industrial tools and heavy equipment carry warranty?
faqs.answer: All power equipment, HVAC systems, and precision instruments include standard 1 to 3 years corporate replacement warranty, backed by on-site technical inspection.

policies.title: Corporate Procurement Terms & Conditions
policies.content: All purchases are subject to Industrial Edge formal quotation parameters, verified corporate PO submission, and agreed payment terms.

policies.title: Corporate Privacy & Data Protection
policies.content: Industrial Edge enforces strict encryption standards. Enterprise buyer data, transaction invoices, and RFQ pricing agreements are kept strictly confidential.
